title: Toroidal versus centripetal arrangement of the magnetic moment in a Dy4 tetrahedron

synthesis.procedure: One-pot in situ ligand formation: a mixture of Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.1 mmol), 2-hydrazino benzothiazole (0.1 mmol), o-vanillin (0.1 mmol), methanol (10 mL), and Et3N (0.3 mmol) was sealed in a 20 mL glass vial and heated at 90 °C for 1 h under autogenous pressure. After cooling to room temperature over 12 h, yellow block crystals of [Dy4(μ4-O)L2(HL)2(CH3O)4]·4CH3OH·H2O were isolated. L/HL are the doubly and singly deprotonated hydrazone ligands from condensation of 2-hydrazinobenzothiazole and o-vanillin.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: sealed 20 mL glass vial under autogenous pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow block single crystals isolated from the vial after cooling to room temperature.

properties.summary: DC data show χMT falling from 55.60 to 14.77 cm3 K mol−1 (300 to 2 K) because of antiferromagnetic Dy···Dy coupling, with a low-field magnetization feature consistent with a weakly magnetic ground state. Zero-field AC susceptibility shows SMM relaxation (Ueff = 1.97 K) together with Raman relaxation. Ab initio axes are arranged toroidally rather than toward the central μ4-oxo ligand, supporting single-molecule toroic behavior and a small net ground-state moment of about 4.4 μB.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: room temperature, 1 kOe (1000 Oe), polycrystalline sample

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; Orbach plus Raman fit of τ vs 1/T from χ'' maxima

measurements.name: τ0
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; same Orbach–Raman fit
